changelog: Upgraded application launcher icon and splash branding to official Antigravity dark squircle rainbow arch icon
Updated adaptive icon background to #161616 for seamless integration across all Android launchers
Removed all informal emojis across the application UI and replaced them with premium, crisp Material vector icons
Enhanced telemetry, permission rules, settings presets, and tool call cards with clean typography and vector badges
Integrated Opera Design System: Opera Red (#FF1A1A) interaction color, warm cream editorial canvas (#FEFBF6), and sleek dark mode (#0F0F0E)
Added authentic Opera fonts: Petrona (display serif), Figtree (reading sans), and Fragment Mono (UI chrome)
New animated Opera App Opening Splash Screen with glowing aura, spring scale entrance, and smooth wipe reveal
Restyled chat composer with Opera 20dp pill, Opera Red action button, and custom typography
Redesigned user message bubble as Opera Red pill with white Figtree font and subtle border
Restyled empty state greeting with Opera butterfly hero mascot and Petrona display header
